analogy.rationale: HIF1A is stabilized by hypoxia or hydroxylase inhibition, but these cell lines are cultured in normoxia and HIF1A activation alone typically produces a modest transcriptional footprint; angiogenesis/VEGFR classes share the hypoxia-angiogenesis axis, while HMGCR, PPAR, and oxidative stress classes have weaker or indirect overlap.
